title: The Elect Solution
description: A comprehensive e-commerce platform featuring a structured product catalog, reusable component architecture, and a real-time interactive map interface that streamlines location-based customer interaction and seamless ordering flow.
highlights: Interactive map integration for customer delivery & locations
Modular product filtering & responsive catalog grid
Smooth checkout and modern UI component flow

title: Akademi School Dashboard
description: An enterprise-grade school management and analytics dashboard with dedicated submodules for students, teachers, finance tracking, and activities. Built with reusable modular components, React Router navigation, and dynamic chart visualizations.
highlights: Interactive Recharts analytics for financial & student trends
Multi-page administrative navigation with React Router
Activity logs, calendar scheduling, and user management modules

title: Job Listing Platform
description: A high-performance job discovery platform engineered with React and Tailwind CSS. Provides job seekers with quick filtering across roles, categories, and locations, accompanied by clean modern typography and smooth card interactions.
highlights: Dynamic rendering of job listings with real-time query filtering
Responsive layout optimized for handheld to desktop viewports
Accessible tag-based navigation and structured modal details

title: Interactive E-Commerce Store
description: A responsive shopping application featuring real-time interactive cart state management, product catalog filters, authentication UI flow, and smooth transition feedback for customers.
highlights: Full interactive cart system with item quantity & total calculation
